facts.raw_span: A 74-year-old man
antero-septal STEMI treated with primary PCI and stenting from the left main to the LAD
dyslipidemia, overweight (BMI 25.8 kg/m²), active smoker
surgically repaired infra-renal abdominal aortic aneurysm
unremarkable cardiovascular and respiratory findings
mild LV dilation (EDD 57 mm), LVEF 46% due to anterior/mid-septal and apical akinesia
grade II diastolic dysfunction
severe LA enlargement
sclerotic aortic and mitral leaflets with mild AR and moderate MR
a ~9 mm round, hyperechoic mass adherent to the ventricular surface of the anterior tricuspid leaflet
a 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet with a “finger-in-glove” blind-ended protrusion
the patient remained asymptomatic
